title: His father and uncle as musicians, and worry that history is lost
summary: Russ names his father, mother and uncle Bob, a strong player, who played in the same bands; he laments that younger people cannot tell his life or the bands he played with.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
